implemented: Provider-neutral additive visual request/result port with image formats, scope epochs, cancellation, deadline and egress metadata. Default runtime remains unconfigured and cannot enable a camera.

Ephemeral explicit session camera lease, one-use clock challenge, conservative capture-time mapping, source/scope invalidation, stop/expiry callback, finite rate/size/queue/deadline admission and buffer disposal. A cancelled non-settling provider retains the one model slot until bounded retirement, then becomes unavailable.

Authenticated local-password and CSRF-protected capability, camera and multipart batch routes enforce exact session/Assistant/private endpoint scope. Synthetic provider/source injection is restricted to loopback test profile; without it the route reports unavailable and cannot activate capture.

One reserved bounded multipart envelope, exact UUID-named JPEG/PNG parts, 1 MiB metadata and an advertised tighter 1 MiB/frame profile, zero-copy part views and explicit wiping. One upload/session and four/host; five-second absolute upload deadline and disconnect cleanup. PNG chunk/CRC/end and JPEG scan/end validation is structural, not pixel decoding.

Synthetic HTTP/component tests cover unconfigured fallback, authenticated negotiation, idempotent camera command, binary digest, upload contention, audience/security retirement and Assistant lease isolation. Fixture observations are scripted and do not derive from image pixels.

Browser conversation camera availability, explicit Enable and persistent state/source/Stop controls. Negotiation precedes source preparation, challenge refreshed after preparation, foreground scope watchdog, immediate local stop, delayed grant disposal and no reconnect/background auto-resume. No default capture adapter or physical camera is selected.

Idle lease expiry releases capture without further polling; batches recheck current capture/interpretation/egress authority; stale requests cannot revoke successor leases. Disconnected HTTP clients cancel exact-lease processing. Runtime camera controls survive administration idle expiry while still requiring current conversation authentication and Assistant permission.

Interpretation deadlines include queue time; failed, rejected or timed-out observations clear current visual usability. Pending buffers are wiped before replacement copies. Owned/reserved encoded allocation measured at 10,518,528 bytes/session; socket, parsed metadata, decoder and provider-private allocation excluded.

Public compact HTTP adapter schema, types and shared request validation; validated success responses carry an explicit adapter identity. This independently authored adapter is distinct from the canonical provider envelope. Browser refuses missing/wrong adapter identity and unsupported versions before preparing a source; malformed grants and renewals fail closed.

Legacy ordinary text requests continue before/after unavailable or unsupported visual input and after restart. Authenticated session identity persists while camera leases and existing volatile dialogue do not. Chrome tests of the real conversation room with synthetic legacy 404/unsupported services keep typed replies and speech controls usable. Repeated text delivery is not replay qualification.
Multipart UUID format validation accepts uppercase UUID syntax consistently with the HTTP contract while preserving exact metadata/part identifier matching.
